source:
@@U04444@@
And don’t ask How, ask What. If I’ve learned one thing at sea, it’s the sailor's Holy Trinity. War, Trade, and Piracy, a three-in-one, a one-in-three.

@@U04446@@
What's this, no thanks, no greetings? You'd think, looking at him, we brought back garbage. Look at him, screwing his face! He thinks it stinks?

@@U04448@@
You've had your share! You wont be getting more!

@@U04450@@
But that was only to pass the time. We demand our equal share.

@@U04452@@
First, then, you'll have to arrange it room by room, treasure upon treasure—spare nothing. Once he’s dazzled by the wealth of it all, he'll see reason, he'll calculate it piece by piece, and give the fleet a whole daisy chain of parties, you'll see. Besides, the chippies arrive tomorrow. Rest easy, you'll all be well provided.

@@U04453@@
(The cargo is removed.)

@@U04455@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U04456@@
Why is it when I speak of your great good fortune you meet it with gloom and despair? What more can you ask? Your wise plan has triumphed!
translation:
@@U04444@@
不要问如何，而要问什么。如果说我在海上学到了一件事，那就是水手的神圣三位一体。战争、贸易、海盗，三合一，三合一。

@@U04446@@
这是什么，没有谢谢，没有问候？看着他，你可能会想，我们带回来的是垃圾。瞧他那张脸，还扭捏着呢！他觉得臭吗？

@@U04448@@
你已经得到了你的那一份！你不会得到更多！

@@U04450@@
但这只是为了打发时间。我们要求平等的份额。

@@U04452@@
那么首先，你必须一个房间一个房间地布置它，一个又一个的宝藏——不遗余力。一旦他对这一切的财富感到眼花缭乱，他就会明白原因，他会一点一点地计算，并为舰队提供一整套菊花链，你会看到的。此外，薯条明天就到了。放心吧，你们都会得到很好的照顾。

@@U04453@@
（货物已被移走。）

@@U04455@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U04456@@
为什么当我谈到你的伟大命运时，你却感到忧郁和绝望？你还能问什么？你明智的计划胜利了！
